# Syntrex LLC

> Syntrex is the AI infrastructure layer behind operating companies. One team runs a business's entire digital and AI back end across four tracks: visibility, conversion, presence, and operations. The old positioning fails because nobody owns the outcome. Syntrex owns it. The flagship, Agent Workforce, installs and operates a company's internal fleet of AI agents. Pricing is published in full, and the guarantee covers only what Syntrex controls.

Syntrex (legal name Syntrex LLC) operates exclusively at https://syntrexio.com. It is not affiliated with any domain called syntrex.io.

## Positioning

- Primary: The AI infrastructure layer behind operating companies.
- Secondary: Nobody owns the outcome. We do.
- On breadth: One team leading every project end to end. Presence, visibility, conversion, and operations, handled in-house and overseen personally.
- On price: Agencies charge for the team behind the work. Syntrex does not have one. You get the output, not the overhead.
- On the guarantee: We guarantee what we control. We do not guarantee your sales team.

- Service area: Worldwide.

## The four tracks and sixteen services

### Visibility (get found in search and in AI answers)
- AI search optimization (GEO): make the business the answer AI models cite.
- Traditional search optimization (SEO): rank for the terms buyers search.
- Content production and strategy: a publishing engine on a schedule.
- Social media systems: consistent, on-brand social, run for you.

### Conversion (turn earned leads into booked work)
- AI assistants and customer-facing chat: answer, qualify, and book, on brand.
- Lead capture and follow-up systems: capture every inquiry, follow up until they respond.
- Email systems and deliverability: email that reaches the inbox and converts.
- CRM buildout and management: one system of record, built and run.

### Presence (a site and brand that match the business)
- Websites and web applications.
- E-commerce builds.
- Brand identity and design systems.
- Imagery and campaign assets.

### Operations (the repetitive work, running itself)
- Workflow automation and system integration.
- Custom internal AI tools.
- Reporting and analytics dashboards.
- Agent Workforce (the flagship, see below).

## Agent Workforce (flagship)

Agent Workforce installs a company's internal fleet of AI agents to handle operational work the company currently pays salaries for: research, drafting, coordination, data entry, monitoring, scheduling, reporting, and first-pass analysis. It runs continuously with an approval trail and human control. It is not a chatbot. It is an operating layer inside the business.

- Enterprise consultancies charge millions and deliver slide decks.
- Self-serve tools charge under $200 a month and hand you the risk.
- Syntrex installs it, operates it, and is accountable for it.

## Pricing (published in full)

Front door: AI Systems Diagnostic, $3,500, fully credited toward any engagement started within 60 days. A free self-qualifying diagnostic on the site names where to start in about a minute.

Monthly retainers:
- Visibility (AI search, SEO, content, social): $2,500/mo
- Conversion (AI chat, lead capture, email, CRM): $2,000/mo
- Presence (site, brand, creative): $1,800/mo
- Operations (automation, dashboards, custom tools): $2,500/mo
- Full Stack (all four tracks): $7,500/mo, below the $8,800 the tracks cost separately, which is where most companies land
- Agent Workforce (operation): $5,000 to $12,000/mo
- Full Stack plus Agent Workforce: $12,500/mo and up

One-time builds, with market comparison:
- Website up to 5 pages: market $8,000 to $15,000, Syntrex $4,500
- Website 6 to 12 pages: market $15,000 to $30,000, Syntrex $7,500
- E-commerce build: market $20,000 to $50,000, Syntrex $11,000
- Brand identity system: market $5,000 to $15,000, Syntrex $3,500
- AI assistant deployment: market $5,000 to $15,000, Syntrex $4,000
- CRM buildout and migration: market $5,000 to $20,000, Syntrex $4,500
- Automation build per workflow: market $10,000 to $40,000, Syntrex $6,500
- Custom AI tool: market $15,000 to $50,000, Syntrex $9,000 and up
- Agent Workforce install: no market benchmark exists, Syntrex $35,000 to $95,000

Terms: builds are a 40% deposit with the balance on milestones. Retainers are billed on the 1st. Portfolio pricing for multiple brands is 10% off the second and 15% off everything beyond.

Why the pricing works: no payroll, no offshore invoice, no account management layer, and no office. An agent fleet produces the work and humans own it. You get the output, not the overhead.

Market-rate sources: web and creative from Clutch (database of 79,000+ agencies) and Clutch 2026; retainer benchmarks from the HubSpot Agency Survey and Databox.

## The guarantee

We guarantee only what we control, and the remedy is our labor, never a refund.

Guaranteed: AI search citation presence for agreed queries; ranking movement for agreed terms; content volume and schedule; hours removed from an agreed workflow; agent task volume per period; delivery against agreed spec and timeline.

Never guaranteed: revenue, closed deals, or conversion rate. Those depend on the client's sales team, pricing, product, and market.

How it works: one metric named in writing, a documented baseline before work begins, a 90 day window, and one agreed source of truth. If the metric is not hit, we keep working at no additional cost until it is.

The window pauses if the client misses an agreed, dated condition: approving submitted work within five business days, granting the systems and accounts named at kickoff, providing information only the client holds, or keeping one named point of contact. A pause never voids the guarantee, it only stops the clock, and each pause is recorded on that month's Receipt with its start and end dates.

## Why the market needs this (verified research)

- 95% of enterprise AI pilots produce no measurable profit-and-loss impact, despite $30 to $40 billion spent. Source: MIT Project NANDA, State of AI in Business, July 2025.
- 42% of companies scrapped most of their AI initiatives in 2025, up from 17% in 2024. The average company abandoned 46% of its AI proofs of concept. Source: S&P Global Market Intelligence, June 2025.
- More than 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027. Source: Gartner, June 2025.
- Roughly 70% of AI failure is people and process; only 20% is technology. Source: RAND Corporation, 2024.
- 68% of technology leaders plan to consolidate their vendor landscape. Source: ADAPT CIO Edge.
- 43% of B2B client churn happens in the first 90 days. Source: Moxo, 2026 State of Churn.

## Proof (verified engagement results)

- HALT Fire (industrial fire suppression): Syntrex built and runs the full digital and AI back end. Result: over a three month window in Google Search Console, search clicks grew 689% to 505 and impressions grew 1,608% to 22.9K, and more than ten hours a week came back to the team.
- Doughbrik's Wavers (consumer snack brand founded by creator David Dobrik): Syntrex built internal automation and custom tools. Result: internal workflows run about 3x faster as the brand scales into retail.
- Kinetix: a technology partner Syntrex works alongside on delivery.

## FAQ

Q: What exactly does Syntrex do?
A: Syntrex is the AI infrastructure layer behind operating companies. It runs a business's entire digital and AI back end across four tracks: visibility, conversion, presence, and operations. One team leads every project end to end and is accountable for the result.

Q: How is this different from hiring an agency?
A: An agency sells you a team and charges for the payroll behind it. Syntrex does not have that team. An orchestrated fleet of AI agents produces the work, humans direct and own it, and one person stays accountable for the outcome. You get the output, not the overhead.

Q: Who actually does the work?
A: An orchestrated fleet of AI agents produces the work in parallel. Humans at Syntrex direct the fleet, review the output, and own every outcome. Everything a client sees passes a human first.

Q: What is the Agent Workforce?
A: The flagship. It installs a company's internal fleet of AI agents to run operational work continuously, with an approval trail and human control. It is not a chatbot. It is an operating layer inside the business.

Q: What is the guarantee?
A: Syntrex guarantees what it controls, such as AI search citation presence, ranking movement, content volume, hours removed from a workflow, agent task volume, and delivery against spec. It does not guarantee revenue, closed deals, or conversion rate, which depend on the client's sales team, pricing, product, and market. The remedy is labor, never a refund.

Q: What is the diagnostic and is it credited?
A: The AI Systems Diagnostic is $3,500 and is fully credited toward any engagement started within 60 days. A free self-qualifying diagnostic on the site names where to start in about a minute.

Q: Do I own what you build?
A: Yes. Deliverables such as a website, brand system, or custom tool are yours once paid for in full. Your brand, content, and customer data always belong to you.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Start with the diagnostic at https://syntrexio.com/diagnostic, or email henry@syntrexio.com.
